meta.name: platform-detector
meta.description: Detect the target platforms a project is being built for (web, mobile iOS, mobile Android, desktop, console, embedded, server, edge, browser extension, game engine, AI agent, CLI, library), the runtime environments behind them, the store or distribution policy that applies, and the platform-specific quality constraints that must shape architecture and security. Use after init-project when the stack must be matched to the right testing matrix, accessibility floor, store-policy gate, performance budget, and security track (OWASP web/LLM/agentic or mobile MASVS) before architecture or implementation work begins.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 识别项目平台，匹配对应安全与质量要求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在动手写代码前想先厘清各平台约束
copy.tagline_en: Identify target platforms and match relevant security and quality requirements
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to clarify platform constraints before starting architecture

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会分析项目面向哪些平台(网页、手机、电脑、游戏机等),并产出一张平台矩阵表:每个平台对应的安全标准、测试要求、性能预算和发布渠道。它还会指出平台之间的冲突,并交给后续技能处理。
howto.when: 在 init-project 之后、开始架构设计前触发,用于确定项目要发布到哪些平台。若用户未指定,Claude 会先提出候选平台,请用户确认后再锁定。

say.text: 这个项目面向 iOS 和 Android,列出平台矩阵。
say.note: Claude 会为每个平台匹配安全标准和测试要求。

say.text: 这是一个 Node.js 后端服务,帮我判断目标平台并给出安全轨道。
say.note: Claude 会指定 web 安全轨道,并生成测试矩阵。

say.text: 我不确定平台,请根据技术栈推断候选,再让我确认。
say.note: Claude 会列出候选平台并请你确认后再锁定。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude detects the platforms a project targets, builds a matrix (runtime, distribution, accessibility, performance, security, testing, telemetry per platform), assigns security tracks and testing floors, and lists conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggers after init-project, before architecture work, to lock the target platforms. If the user named none, it derives candidates and asks for confirmation.

say_en.text: This project targets iOS and Android. Generate the platform matrix.
say_en.note: Claude will map each platform to security and testing requirements.

say_en.text: This is a Node.js backend. Determine the platform and security track.
say_en.note: Claude will assign the web security track and set a testing floor.

say_en.text: I'm not sure of platforms. Infer candidates from the stack and let me confirm.
say_en.note: Claude will propose candidates and wait for confirmation.
